diff --git a/.github/workflows/e2e.yml b/.github/workflows/e2e.yml
index 94e9ee0..e4758ca 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/e2e.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/e2e.yml
@@ -4,6 +4,10 @@ on:
   push:
   pull_request:
   workflow_dispatch:
+  # Nightly on main, so there is a run per day even when nobody pushes:
+  # that history is what razo's triage reads to tell a regression from a flake.
+  schedule:
+    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
 
 jobs:
   test:
@@ -27,3 +31,15 @@ jobs:
         run: npx razo-upload --url https://razo.ar/api/ingest
         env:
           RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN }}
+
+      # Keep the raw razo-steps.json of every run, green ones included: a green
+      # run is the "last known good" a later failure gets compared against.
+      # One artifact per attempt so re-runs never overwrite each other.
+      - name: Keep test-results as an artifact
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: razo-test-results-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: test-results/
+          retention-days: 30
+          if-no-files-found: warn

message: ci: morning triage after the nightly run
author: Michel Lombardo

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/triage/triage.config.yaml b/.github/triage/triage.config.yaml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..616a004
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/triage/triage.config.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+# Morning triage for this repository, run by .github/workflows/triage.yml.
+# Paths are relative to the repository root, where the workflow runs the CLI.
+baseBranch: main
+source:
+  plugin: razo-source
+  config: { dataDir: .razo }
+pull:
+  repo: razohq/razo-demo
+  token: "${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
+  workflow: e2e.yml
+  branch: main
+code:
+  plugin: github
+  config: { repo: razohq/razo-demo, token: "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" }
+notifiers:
+  - plugin: markdown
+    config: { outDir: triage-reports }
+  - plugin: http
+    config: { url: "https://razo.ar/api/triage/reports", token: "${RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN}" }
+store:
+  plugin: json-file
+  config: { path: .razo/triage-state.json }

diff --git a/.github/workflows/triage.yml b/.github/workflows/triage.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e74ecde
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/triage.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+name: triage
+
+# The morning triage: once the nightly e2e run on main has finished, read the
+# last two weeks of runs, cluster and classify the failures, and deliver the
+# report to razo.ar's Triage tab. The engine is @razohq/triage, built from
+# razohq/razo because it is not published to npm yet.
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: [e2e]
+    types: [completed]
+    branches: [main]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+# One triage at a time: two overlapping runs would each restore the same state
+# and upload two diverging ones.
+concurrency:
+  group: razo-triage
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read     # list the e2e runs and download their artifacts and the previous state
+  contents: read    # compare commits and read their diffs
+
+jobs:
+  triage:
+    # Only after the nightly, not after every push or PR run of e2e.
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.event == 'schedule'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: razohq/razo
+          path: .razo-engine
+
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+          cache: npm
+          cache-dependency-path: .razo-engine/package-lock.json
+
+      - name: Build the triage engine
+        working-directory: .razo-engine
+        env:
+          PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD: '1'
+        run: |
+          npm ci
+          npm run build -w @razohq/triage
+
+      # Restores the previous state from the latest razo-triage-state artifact
+      # of a main-branch run, then downloads the e2e runs it has not seen yet.
+      - name: Pull runs and state
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN }}
+        run: node .razo-engine/packages/triage/dist/cli.js pull --config .github/triage/triage.config.yaml --since 14d
+
+      - name: Triage the last day
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAZO_INGEST_TOKEN }}
+        run: node .razo-engine/packages/triage/dist/cli.js run --config .github/triage/triage.config.yaml --since 24h --lookback 14d
+
+      # Saved only when the morning was delivered: triage run fails before
+      # saving anything if a notifier fails, and this step does not run then.
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: razo-triage-state
+          path: .razo/triage-state.json
+          retention-days: 90
+
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: triage-report-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: triage-reports/
+          retention-days: 30
+          if-no-files-found: ignore
